verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own API for adding candidates, listing hires, and hosting a careers page, so some product functions can be driven programmatically without the UI. However, there is no evidence of a CLI, CI integration, or full headless operation, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented CLI or CI usage, auth/token guidance for unattended runs, breadth of API coverage across the ATS workflow, an OpenAPI/reference spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Add candidates, list hires, and host a custom careers page with the Dover API.
